content.shloka:
Sukhkarta Dukhharta Varta Vighnachi
Nurvi Purvi Prem Krupa Jayachi
Sarvangi Sundar Uti Shendurachi
Kanthi Jhalke Mal Mukta Phalachi
content.meaning: O remover of sorrows and obstacles, you are the one who bestows happiness. Your entire body is beautiful, adorned with vermilion. Around your neck shines a garland of pearls.
content.transliteration:
Sukhkartā dukhhartā vārtā vighnāchī
Nurvī purvī prem krupā jāyachī
Sarvāṅgī sundar uṭī sheṃdurāchī
Kaṇṭhī jhaḷake māḷ muktāphāḷāchī

content.shloka:
Jai Dev Jai Dev Jai Mangal Murti
Darshan Matre Man Kaamna Purti
Jai Dev Jai Dev
content.meaning: Victory to you, O Lord, victory to you, O auspicious one! Merely by your sight, all desires of the mind are fulfilled.
content.transliteration:
Jai dev jai dev jai maṅgal mūrtī
Darśan mātre man kāmanā pūrtī
Jai dev jai dev

content.shloka:
Ratnakhachit Phara Tujha Gaurikumara
Chandanachi Uti Kumkumkeshara
Hire Jad-it Mukut Shobhato Bara
Runhzunhti Nupure Charni Ghagara
content.meaning: O son of Gauri, your forehead is studded with gems. You are anointed with sandalwood paste and saffron. A diamond-studded crown adorns you beautifully. Anklets and bells tinkle on your feet.
content.transliteration:
Ratnakhachit phara tujhā gaurīkumārā
Chandanāchī uṭī kumkumkesharā
Hīre jaḍit mukuṭ śobhato bārā
Runhzunhtī nūpure charaṇī ghāgarā

content.shloka:
Jai Dev Jai Dev Jai Mangal Murti
Darshan Matre Man Kaamna Purti
Jai Dev Jai Dev
content.meaning: Victory to you, O Lord, victory to you, O auspicious one! Merely by your sight, all desires of the mind are fulfilled.
content.transliteration:
Jai dev jai dev jai maṅgal mūrtī
Darśan mātre man kāmanā pūrtī
Jai dev jai dev

content.shloka:
Lambodara Pitambara Phanivarvandana
Saral Sond Vakratunda Trinayana
Das Ramacha Vat Pahe Sadana
Sankashti Pavave Nirvani Rakshave
Survar Vandana
content.meaning: O pot-bellied one, draped in yellow silk, worshipped by the serpent king, with a curved trunk and three eyes. The servant of Rama awaits at your door. Please protect us from calamities and grant us salvation, O Lord worshipped by the gods.
content.transliteration:
Laṃbodarā pītāṃbarā phaṇīvaravandanā
Saraḷ soṃḍ vakratuṇḍa trīnayānā
Dās Rāmāchā vāṭ pāhe sadanā
Saṅkaṣṭī pāvāve nirvāṇī rakṣāve
Survarvandanā

content.shloka:
Jai Dev Jai Dev Jai Mangal Murti
Darshan Matre Man Kaamna Purti
Jai Dev Jai Dev
content.meaning: Victory to you, O Lord, victory to you, O auspicious one! Merely by your sight, all desires of the mind are fulfilled.
content.transliteration:
Jai dev jai dev jai maṅgal mūrtī
Darśan mātre man kāmanā pūrtī
Jai dev jai dev

content.shloka:
Durge Durghat Bhari Tujvin Sansari
Anath Nathe Ambabai
Tujvin Kone Puri
Aarti Amba Bai
content.meaning: O Durga, you fill all difficulties with your presence. In this world, without you, all are orphans. O mother Ambabai, without you, who else is there for us?
content.transliteration:
Durge durghaṭ bhārī tujviṇ saṃsārī
Anāth nāthe Aṃbābāī
Tujviṇ koṇe purī
Āratī Aṃbābāī

content.shloka:
Kanak Saman Deha Tejah Punjakara
Mukutashobit Kundale Bari
Hirya Jad-it Har Guloband Galyasari
Aarti Amba Bai
content.meaning: Your body shines like gold, you are the embodiment of divine light. Your crown and earrings are splendid, adorned with necklaces studded with diamonds around your neck.
content.transliteration:
Kanak samān dehā tejah puṃjakārā
Mukuṭaśobhit kuṇḍale bārī
Hīryā jaḍit hār gulobaṃd gāḷyāsarī
Āratī Aṃbābāī

content.shloka:
Trigun Roop Tuze Gunan Paresari
Chaturanan Vakte Na Puri Lila Tuzi
Aarti Amba Bai
content.meaning: You embody the three gunas (qualities), your virtues are beyond measure. Even the four-faced Brahma cannot fully describe your divine play.
content.transliteration:
Triguṇ rūp tujhe guṇāṃ pāresarī
Chaturānana vakte nā purī līlā tujhī
Āratī Aṃbābāī

content.shloka:
Saranagat Rakshi Davi Sada Jananiye
Mahi Mahishashur Mardini Tujhe Gunagava
Charan Kamalasi Datt Mano Raghunathane
Aarti Amba Bai
content.meaning: O Goddess, you always protect those who seek your refuge. O destroyer of the demon Mahishasura, I sing your praises. Raghunath humbly bows at your lotus feet.
content.transliteration:
Śaraṇāgat rākṣī devī sadā jananīye
Mahiṣāsura mardīnī tujhe guṇagāve
Charaṇ kamālāsī datta mano Raghunāthane
Āratī Aṃbābāī

content.shloka:
Durge Durghat Bhari Tujvin Sansari
Anath Nathe Ambabai
Tujvin Kone Puri
Aarti Amba Bai
content.meaning: O Durga, you fill all difficulties with your presence. In this world, without you, all are orphans. O mother Ambabai, without you, who else is there for us?
content.transliteration:
Durge durghaṭ bhārī tujviṇ saṃsārī
Anāth nāthe Aṃbābāī
Tujviṇ koṇe purī
Āratī Aṃbābāī

content.shloka:
Yei Oh Vitthale Majha Rakhumaicha Vitthale
Pundalikavarade Majha Pandhariche Vitthale
Aarti Saptashrungi
content.meaning: Come, O Vitthal, the beloved of Rakhumai. O Vitthal of Pandharpur, who blessed Pundalik.
content.transliteration:
Yeī o Viṭṭhale mājhā Rakhumāīchā Viṭṭhale
Puṇḍalīkāvarāde mājhā Paṃḍharīche Viṭṭhale
Āratī Saptaśṛṅgī

content.shloka:
Kanhopatra Majhi Dasi Janee Majhi Dasi
Savaraa Majhi Dasi Namayanchi Dasi
Yei Oh Vitthale
content.meaning: Kanhopatra is my devotee, Janai is my devotee, Savata is my devotee, the devotee of Namadev. Come, O Vitthal.
content.transliteration:
Kānhopatrā mājhī dāsī Jānī mājhī dāsī
Sāvarā mājhī dāsī Nāmayāṃchī dāsī
Yeī o Viṭṭhale

content.shloka:
Bhanudas Majha Bhakta Jani Majha Bhakta
Kanha Majha Bhakta Namayanchi Dasi
Yei Oh Vitthale
content.meaning: Bhanudas is my devotee, Jani is my devotee, Kanha is my devotee, servants of Namadev. Come, O Vitthal.
content.transliteration:
Bhānudās mājhā bhakta Jānī mājhā bhakta
Kānhā mājhā bhakta Nāmayāṃchī dāsī
Yeī o Viṭṭhale

content.shloka:
Gora Kumhar Majha Bhakta Savata Majha Bhakta
Chokha Majha Bhakta Namayanchi Dasi
Yei Oh Vitthale
content.meaning: Gora the potter is my devotee, Savata is my devotee, Chokha is my devotee, servants of Namadev. Come, O Vitthal.
content.transliteration:
Gorā kuṃbhār mājhā bhakta Savatā mājhā bhakta
Chokhā mājhā bhakta Nāmayāṃchī dāsī
Yeī o Viṭṭhale

content.shloka:
Yei Oh Vitthale Majha Rakhumaicha Vitthale
Pundalikavarade Majha Pandhariche Vitthale
content.meaning: Come, O Vitthal, the beloved of Rakhumai. O Vitthal of Pandharpur, who blessed Pundalik.
content.transliteration:
Yeī o Viṭṭhale mājhā Rakhumāīchā Viṭṭhale
Puṇḍalīkāvarāde mājhā Paṃḍharīche Viṭṭhale

content.shloka:
Lavthavti Vikrala Brahmandi Mala
Vishwayi Devi Mangal Bola
Aarti Bola Aarti Shankarachi
Aarti Bola
content.meaning: The fearsome one, wearing a garland of skulls, Lord of the universe, O Devi speak auspicious words. Perform the aarti, the aarti of Lord Shankar.
content.transliteration:
Lāvathāvatī vikrāḷā brahmaṇḍī māḷā
Viśvayī devī maṅgaḷ bolā
Āratī bolā āratī śaṃkarāchī
Āratī bolā

content.shloka:
Tripurashur Alindile Daitya Mardale
Padasparshe Tarilya Gauti
Mahi Ganga Dharili Shiva Shree Shankarachi
Aarti Bola
content.meaning: He destroyed Tripurasura and slayed the demons. By the touch of his feet, he liberated Gautami. He held the river Ganga on his head, glory to Lord Shankar.
content.transliteration:
Tripurāsur āliṃdile daitya mārdaḷe
Pādasparśe tārilyā Gautī
Mahī Gaṅgā dhariḷī Śivā Śrī Śaṃkarāchī
Āratī bolā

content.shloka:
Dakshacha Makha Dhavala Tripurari Bhala
Surevarachya Mele Bhasma Uddhale
Nagin Char Charitya Mundmala Gale
Aarti Shankarachi Aarti Bola
content.meaning: He destroyed the sacrifice of Daksha, the three-eyed Lord. At the gathering of gods, he smeared sacred ash. Serpents and skulls adorn his neck. Perform the aarti of Lord Shankar.
content.transliteration:
Dakṣāchā makhā dhāvaḷā tripurārī bhāla
Surevārāchyā meḷe bhasma uddhaḷe
Nāgiṇ chār chāritya muṇḍamāḷā gaḷe
Āratī Śaṃkarāchī āratī bolā

content.shloka:
Mani Maha Dev Mahadev Mhaisivar Bola
Gangi Gouri Shankar Aarti Bola
Aarti Bola Aarti Shankarachi
Aarti Bola
content.meaning: Recite the name of Mahadev, the great Lord of Mahisa. Sing the aarti of Shankar, husband of Gangi and Gouri. Perform the aarti of Lord Shankar.
content.transliteration:
Maṇī Mahādev Mahādev mhaīsvar bolā
Gaṅgī Gourī Śaṃkar āratī bolā
Āratī bolā āratī Śaṃkarāchī
Āratī bolā

content.shloka:
Lavthavti Vikrala Brahmandi Mala
Vishwayi Devi Mangal Bola
Aarti Bola Aarti Shankarachi
Aarti Bola
content.meaning: The fearsome one, wearing a garland of skulls, Lord of the universe, O Devi speak auspicious words. Perform the aarti, the aarti of Lord Shankar.
content.transliteration:
Lāvathāvatī vikrāḷā brahmaṇḍī māḷā
Viśvayī devī maṅgaḷ bolā
Āratī bolā āratī Śaṃkarāchī
Āratī bolā

content.shloka:
Om Jai Lakshmi Mata Maiya Jai Lakshmi Mata
Tumko Nishdin Sevat Hari Vishnu Vidhata
Om Jai Lakshmi Mata
content.meaning: Om, glory to Mother Lakshmi. Hari, Vishnu, and Brahma serve you day and night. Glory to Mother Lakshmi.
content.transliteration:
Oṃ jai Lakṣmī Mātā Maiyā jai Lakṣmī Mātā
Tumko niśdin sevat Hari Viṣṇu Vidhātā
Oṃ jai Lakṣmī Mātā

content.shloka:
Uma Rama Brahmani Tum Hi Jag Mata
Surya Chandrama Dhyavat Narad Rishi Gata
Om Jai Lakshmi Mata
content.meaning: You are Uma, Rama, and Brahmani, you are the Mother of the world. The sun, moon, and sage Narad meditate upon you and sing your praises.
content.transliteration:
Umā Ramā Brahmaṇī tum hī jag Mātā
Sūrya Chandramā dhyāvat Nārad ṛṣi gātā
Oṃ jai Lakṣmī Mātā

content.shloka:
Durga Roop Niranjani Sukh Sampatti Data
Jo Koi Tumko Dhyavat Riddhi Siddhi Dhan Pata
Om Jai Lakshmi Mata
content.meaning: You are the pure form of Durga, the bestower of happiness and wealth. Whoever meditates upon you attains supernatural powers and wealth.
content.transliteration:
Durgā rūp nirañjanī sukh saṃpatti dātā
Jo koī tumko dhyāvat ṛddhi siddhi dhan pātā
Oṃ jai Lakṣmī Mātā

content.shloka:
Tum Patal Nivasini Tum Hi Shubh Data
Karma Prabhav Prakashini Bhavnidhi Ki Trata
Om Jai Lakshmi Mata
content.meaning: You reside in the netherworld, you are the bestower of auspiciousness. You illuminate the effects of karma and save us from the ocean of worldly existence.
content.transliteration:
Tum pātāl nivāsinī tum hī śubh dātā
Karma prabhāv prakāśinī bhavnidhi kī trātā
Oṃ jai Lakṣmī Mātā

content.shloka:
Jis Ghar Mein Tum Rahti Sab Sadgun Aata
Sab Sambhav Ho Jata Man Nahi Ghabrata
Om Jai Lakshmi Mata
content.meaning: In the home where you dwell, all virtues come. Everything becomes possible and the mind is free from fear.
content.transliteration:
Jis ghar meṃ tum rahtī sab sadguṇ ātā
Sab saṃbhav ho jātā man nahīṃ ghabrātā
Oṃ jai Lakṣmī Mātā

content.shloka:
Tum Bin Yagya Na Hove Vastra Na Koi Pata
Khan Pan Ka Vaibhav Sab Tumse Ata
Om Jai Lakshmi Mata
content.meaning: Without you, no sacred rituals can be performed, no one can obtain garments. The grandeur of food and drink all comes from you.
content.transliteration:
Tum bin yajña na hove vastra na koī pātā
Khān pān kā vaibhav sab tumse ātā
Oṃ jai Lakṣmī Mātā

content.shloka:
Shubhgun Mandir Sundar Kshirodadhi Jata
Ratan Chaturdash Tum Bin Koi Nahi Pata
Om Jai Lakshmi Mata
content.meaning: O beautiful abode of auspicious qualities, born from the ocean of milk. Without you, no one can obtain the fourteen jewels.
content.transliteration:
Śubhguṇ mandir sundar kṣīrodadhi jātā
Ratan chaturdaś tum bin koī nahīṃ pātā
Oṃ jai Lakṣmī Mātā

content.shloka:
Mahalakshmiji Ki Aarti Jo Koi Jan Gate
Ur Anand Samata Paap Utar Jate
Om Jai Lakshmi Mata
content.meaning: Whoever sings this aarti of Mahalakshmi, their heart is filled with joy and all sins are washed away.
content.transliteration:
Mahālakṣmījī kī āratī jo koī jan gāte
Ur ānaṃd samātā pāp utar jāte
Oṃ jai Lakṣmī Mātā

content.shloka:
Om Jai Saraswati Mata Maiya Jai Saraswati Mata
Sadguna Vaibhav Shalin Tribhuvan Vikhyata
Om Jai Saraswati Mata
content.meaning: Om, glory to Mother Saraswati. You are endowed with virtues and splendor, famous in all three worlds. Glory to Mother Saraswati.
content.transliteration:
Oṃ jai Sarasvatī Mātā Maiyā jai Sarasvatī Mātā
Sadguṇ vaibhav śālin tribhuvan vikhyātā
Oṃ jai Sarasvatī Mātā

content.shloka:
Chandra Vadani Padmasini Dyutigunvari
Shubh Vasana Virajit Kanthi Motihari
Om Jai Saraswati Mata
content.meaning: Moon-faced, seated on a lotus, radiant with divine qualities. Dressed in pure garments and adorned with a pearl necklace.
content.transliteration:
Chandra vadanī padmāsinī dyutiguṇvārī
Śubh vāsanā virājit kaṇṭhī motīhārī
Oṃ jai Sarasvatī Mātā

content.shloka:
Veenavadini Var De Sab Vidhya Dani
Tum Bhavasgari Tarini Dukh Nivarini
Om Jai Saraswati Mata
content.meaning: O player of the veena, bestower of boons, giver of all knowledge. You help us cross the ocean of worldly existence and remove all sorrows.
content.transliteration:
Vīṇāvādinī var de sab vidyā dānī
Tum bhavasāgarī tāriṇī duḥkh nivāriṇī
Oṃ jai Sarasvatī Mātā

content.shloka:
Kahi Brahma Vishnu Mahesh Tumhey Nit Pujey
Aur Sakal Janparisha Bhi Tumhein Bhajey
Om Jai Saraswati Mata
content.meaning: Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesh worship you constantly. All beings in the universe also sing your praises.
content.transliteration:
Kahī Brahmā Viṣṇu Maheś tumheṃ nit pūjeṃ
Aur sakal janpariṣā bhī tumheṃ bhajeṃ
Oṃ jai Sarasvatī Mātā

content.shloka:
Tum Hi Hansa Vahini Vidya Data Dani
Tribhuvan Mahima Tumhari Sab Jag Jani
Om Jai Saraswati Mata
content.meaning: You ride the swan and bestow knowledge. Your glory in the three worlds is known to all.
content.transliteration:
Tum hī haṃsa vāhinī vidyā dātā dānī
Tribhuvan mahimā tumhārī sab jag jānī
Oṃ jai Sarasvatī Mātā

content.shloka:
Maa Saraswatiji Ki Aarti Jo Koi Nit Gave
Hitkaari Sukh Sampatti Sab Ko Paave
Om Jai Saraswati Mata
content.meaning: Whoever sings this aarti of Mother Saraswati daily, attains beneficial happiness and prosperity.
content.transliteration:
Mā Sarasvatījī kī āratī jo koī nit gāve
Hitkārī sukh saṃpatti sab ko pāve
Oṃ jai Sarasvatī Mātā

content.shloka:
Aarti Shri Ramchandra Ki Jay Bol Hanuman Ki
Lal Deh Lali Lase Aru Dhadhi Topi Lasi
Bahe Bhuja Biral Ki Kandhe Moonj Janeu Saaji
content.meaning: Perform the aarti of Lord Shri Ramchandra, hail the glory of Hanuman. His reddish body gleams beautifully, with a cap atop. His mighty arms are magnificent, and the sacred thread adorns his shoulder.
content.transliteration:
Āratī Śrī Rāmacandra kī jai bol Hanumān kī
Lāl deh lālī lāse aru dhaḍhī ṭopī lāsī
Bāhe bhujā biral kī kāndhe mūṃj janeū sājī

content.shloka:
Chandr Sa Mukh Rajat Hai Jag Mein Sab Se Nyara
Shankar Suvan Kesar Nandan Tej Bala Dhaari
Aarti Shri Ramchandra Ki
content.meaning: His face shines like the moon, unique in all the world. Son of the wind god, anointed with saffron, he possesses great brilliance and strength.
content.transliteration:
Chandra sā mukh rājat hai jag meṃ sab se nyārā
Śaṅkar suvan kesar nandan tej balā dhārī
Āratī Śrī Rāmacandra kī

content.shloka:
Sandhya Hunu Hanuman Lali Palkan Bikh Tekhein
Aanjani Putra Mahaprabhu Aarti Le Ho
Aarti Shri Ramchandra Ki
content.meaning: At dusk, Hanuman is seen with his eyelids slightly open. O great lord, son of Anjani, accept this aarti.
content.transliteration:
Sandhyā hunu Hanumān lālī palkan bikh tekheṃ
Añjanī putra mahāprabhu āratī le ho
Āratī Śrī Rāmacandra kī

content.shloka:
Lanka Viddhvans Kiye Bhai Siya Sudhi Laye
Lakshmana Praan Sahit Prabhu Sab Sukh Daye
Aarti Shri Ramchandra Ki
content.meaning: He destroyed Lanka and brought news of Sita. He saved the life of Lakshmana and brought happiness to all.
content.transliteration:
Laṅkā viddhvaṃs kiye bhāī Siyā sudhī lāye
Lakṣmaṇa prāṇ sahit prabhu sab sukh dāye
Āratī Śrī Rāmacandra kī

content.shloka:
Ko Nahi Janat Hai Jag Mein Kapi Sankar Bhairo
Aanjani Putra Mahaprabhu Shankar Avatara
Aarti Shri Ramchandra Ki Jay Bol Hanuman Ki
content.meaning: Who in the world does not know the monkey deity, an incarnation of Shankar? Son of Anjani, great lord, incarnation of Shankar. Perform the aarti of Lord Ramchandra, hail the glory of Hanuman.
content.transliteration:
Ko nahīṃ jānat hai jag meṃ kapi Saṃkar Bhairo
Añjanī putra mahāprabhu Śaṃkar avatārā
Āratī Śrī Rāmacandra kī jai bol Hanumān kī

content.shloka:
Aarti Kunj Bihari Ki Shri Giridhar Krishna Murari Ki
Gale Mein Baijanti Mala Bajave Murli Madhur Bala
Shravan Mein Kundal Jhala Ke Nand Ke Anand Nandlala
Aarti Kunj Bihari Ki
content.meaning: Perform the aarti of the Lord who dwells in the groves, Shri Giridhar Krishna Murari. He wears the Vaijanti garland around his neck and plays the sweet flute. With earrings dangling from his ears, he is the blissful son of Nanda.
content.transliteration:
Āratī kuñj bihārī kī Śrī Giridhār Kṛṣṇa Murārī kī
Gale meṃ baijantī mālā bājāve muralī madhur bālā
Śravaṇ meṃ kuṇḍal jhālā ke Nand ke ānaṃd Naṃdlālā
Āratī kuñj bihārī kī

content.shloka:
Gagan Sam Ang Kanti Kali Radhika Chamak Rahi
Latkan Se Ban Thanke Taki Sab Pichhari
Aarti Kunj Bihari Ki
content.meaning: His body has the dark radiance of the sky, and Radhika shines beside him like lightning. He stands gracefully in a bending posture, captivating everyone around.
content.transliteration:
Gagan sam aṅg kāntī kālī Rādhikā chamak rahī
Laṭkan se ban ṭhanke tākī sab pichhārī
Āratī kuñj bihārī kī

content.shloka:
Kanhaiya Karat Raas Leela Aaur Gopi Sang
Daras Parat Shobha Prabhu Ka Har Ang
Aarti Kunj Bihari Ki
content.meaning: Krishna performs the Raas Leela with the Gopis. Seeing the Lord, every part of his form appears beautiful.
content.transliteration:
Kanhāiyā karat rās līlā aur Gopī saṅg
Daras parat śobhā Prabhu kā har aṅg
Āratī kuñj bihārī kī

content.shloka:
Kamal Nayan So Jhanki Prabhudine
Bhaktan Ke Sankat Har Liye Tinen
Aarti Kunj Bihari Ki
content.meaning: With his lotus eyes, the Lord gazes upon us. He removes the sufferings of his devotees.
content.transliteration:
Kamal nayan so jhāṃkī Prabhudīne
Bhaktaṃ ke saṃkaṭ har līye tinen
Āratī kuñj bihārī kī

content.shloka:
Aarti Kunj Bihari Ki Shri Giridhar Krishna Murari Ki
Gale Mein Baijanti Mala Bajave Murli Madhur Bala
Aarti Kunj Bihari Ki
content.meaning: Perform the aarti of the Lord who dwells in the groves, Shri Giridhar Krishna Murari. He wears the Vaijanti garland and plays the sweet flute.
content.transliteration:
Āratī kuñj bihārī kī Śrī Giridhār Kṛṣṇa Murārī kī
Gale meṃ baijantī mālā bājāve muralī madhur bālā
Āratī kuñj bihārī kī

content.shloka:
Aarti Kije Hanuman Lala Ki
Dusht Dalan Raghunath Kala Ki
Jake Bal Se Girivar Kaape
Rog Dosh Jake Nikat Na Jhanke
content.meaning: Perform the aarti of dear Hanuman, the destroyer of evil and an aspect of Lord Raghunath. By his strength, mountains tremble. Disease and afflictions dare not come near him.
content.transliteration:
Āratī kīje Hanumān lalā kī
Duṣṭa dalan Raghunāth kālā kī
Jāke bal se girivār kāṃpe
Rog doṣ jāke nikaṭ na jhāṃke

content.shloka:
Anjani Putra Maha Baldai
Santan Ke Prabhu Sada Sahai
De Bira Raghubar Pahuchan Mahin
Bhaktan Ke Karyasiddh Karahin
content.meaning: Son of Anjani, possessing great strength. He is always the helper of saints. Carrying the token of Lord Rama, he accomplishes the tasks of devotees.
content.transliteration:
Añjanī putra mahā baldāī
Santaṃ ke Prabhu sadā sahāī
De bīrā Raghuvīr pahuchān māhīṃ
Bhaktaṃ ke kāryasiddh karāhiṃ

content.shloka:
Lanka Viddhvans Kiye Raghurai
Tulsi Das Sada Hari Cherai
Aarti Kije Hanuman Lala Ki
Dusht Dalan Raghunath Kala Ki
content.meaning: He destroyed Lanka for Lord Rama. Tulsidas always remains a servant of Hari. Perform the aarti of dear Hanuman, the destroyer of evil.
content.transliteration:
Laṅkā viddhvaṃs kiye Raghurāī
Tulsīdās sadā Hari cherā ī
Āratī kīje Hanumān lalā kī
Duṣṭa dalan Raghunāth kālā kī

content.shloka:
Maha Bir Vikram Bajrangi
Kumati Nivar Sumati Ke Sangi
Aarti Kije Hanuman Lala Ki
content.meaning: O great warrior, valiant Bajrangi. You remove evil thoughts and are the companion of the wise. Perform the aarti of dear Hanuman.
content.transliteration:
Mahā bīr bikram Bajraṅgī
Kumati nivār sumati ke saṅgī
Āratī kīje Hanumān lalā kī

content.shloka:
Trigunaavatara Dattatreya Deva
Brahma Vishnu Maheshwara Jaydev
Jai Dev Jai Dev Jai Shri Guru Datta
Avadhuta Chintan Shri Guru Datta
content.meaning: Lord Dattatreya, the incarnation of the three gunas, embodying Brahma, Vishnu, and Maheshwara. Victory to Shri Guru Datta, the liberated one who is the embodiment of pure consciousness.
content.transliteration:
Triguṇāvatāra Dattātreya devā
Brahmā Viṣṇu Maheśvarā jaydev
Jai dev jai dev jai Śrī Guru Dattā
Avadhūta chintan Śrī Guru Dattā

content.shloka:
Sagun Nirgun Dattu Ek Mevha
Bhav Bhay Harana Karuna Ghane Deva
Jai Dev Jai Dev Jai Shri Guru Datta
content.meaning: Dattu is the one who is both with form and formless. O compassionate Lord, you remove the fear of worldly existence.
content.transliteration:
Saguṇ nirguṇ Dattū ek mevhā
Bhav bhay haraṇa karuṇā ghane devā
Jai dev jai dev jai Śrī Guru Dattā

content.shloka:
Savad Roopa Vyapak Digambari
Avagat Lila Hi Atri Kumari
Jai Dev Jai Dev Jai Shri Guru Datta
content.meaning: His all-pervading form is the universe itself, clothed in the directions. His divine play is known only to the son of Atri.
content.transliteration:
Savad rūpā vyāpak digambarī
Avagat līlā hī Atri kumārī
Jai dev jai dev jai Śrī Guru Dattā

content.shloka:
Brahmananda Param Sukh Sampadha
Avadhooti Shobha Ati Sundar Mandha
Jai Dev Jai Dev Jai Shri Guru Datta
content.meaning: The supreme bliss of Brahman, embodying supreme happiness and prosperity. The beauty of the Avadhoot is most charming and gentle.
content.transliteration:
Brahmānaṃda param sukh saṃpadā
Avadhūtī śobhā ati sundar maṃdha
Jai dev jai dev jai Śrī Guru Dattā

content.shloka:
Bhakta Manakamana Kalpadrum Daata
Jai Dev Jai Dev Jai Shri Guru Datta
Avadhuta Chintan Shri Guru Datta
content.meaning: You are the wish-fulfilling tree for devotees' desires. Victory to Shri Guru Datta, the liberated one who is the embodiment of pure consciousness.
content.transliteration:
Bhakta manakāmanā kalpadrum dātā
Jai dev jai dev jai Śrī Guru Dattā
Avadhūta chintan Śrī Guru Dattā

content.shloka:
Aarti Sai Baba Saukhyadatara Jeeva
Charana Rajatali Dyava Dasa Visava
Bhaktaa Visava
Aarti Sai Baba
content.meaning: Perform the aarti of Sai Baba, the bestower of happiness to all beings. Give us the dust of your holy feet and grant rest to your servants and devotees.
content.transliteration:
Āratī Sāī Bābā saukhyadātāra jīvā
Charaṇa rajatāḷī dyāvā dāsa visāvā
Bhaktā visāvā
Āratī Sāī Bābā

content.shloka:
Jaaluniya Aanang Swaswarupee Rahe Danga
Mumukshu Janaa Daawe Nija Dola Sreerangaa
Aarti Sai Baba
content.meaning: Having burnt desire, he remains absorbed in his true self. To the seekers of liberation, he shows them the divine Lord Srirangaa.
content.transliteration:
Jāḷuniyā ānaṅg svasvarūpī rahe ḍaṅgā
Mumukṣu janā dāve nija ḍolā Śrīraṅgā
Āratī Sāī Bābā

content.shloka:
Jayaa Mani Jaisa Bhava Tayaa Taisaa Anubhava
Davisee Daasa Visava Laksha Laavee Hari Guna Gaava
Aarti Sai Baba
content.meaning: As one's feelings are, so is one's experience. O Lord, grant rest to your servants and inspire them to sing the praises of Hari.
content.transliteration:
Jayā manī jaisā bhāvā tayā taisā anubhavā
Davisī dāsa visāvā lakṣa lāvī Hari guṇa gāvā
Āratī Sāī Bābā

content.shloka:
Kaliyugee Avatara Saguna Parabrahma Saachara
Avataarna Jhaalase Swami Datta Digambara
Aarti Sai Baba
content.meaning: The incarnation in this Kali age is the manifest supreme Brahman. Lord Datta Digambar has incarnated.
content.transliteration:
Kaliyugī avatārā saguṇa Parabrahma sāchārā
Avatārṇā jhāḷāse Svāmī Dattā Digambarā
Āratī Sāī Bābā

content.shloka:
Aathan Divasa Guruvaaree Bhakta Karitee Vaaree
Prabhupada Pahataa Hari Guruchi Aarti
Sai Baba Saukhyadatara Jeeva
Aarti Sai Baba
content.meaning: Every Thursday, devotees gather. Beholding the feet of the Lord, they perform the aarti of Guru Hari. Sai Baba, the bestower of happiness to all beings.
content.transliteration:
Āṭhan divasa Guruvārī bhaktā karītī vārī
Prabhupada pahātā Harī Guruchī āratī
Sāī Bābā saukhyadātāra jīvā
Āratī Sāī Bābā

content.shloka:
Shirdee Maajhe Pandharipura Sai Baba Ramavara
Baba Ramavara Sai Baba Ramavara
Aarti Sai Baba
content.meaning: Shirdi is my Pandharpur, and Sai Baba is my Lord Rama. Sai Baba is my beloved Lord.
content.transliteration:
Śirdī mājhe Paṃḍharīpurā Sāī Bābā Rāmavarā
Bābā Rāmavarā Sāī Bābā Rāmavarā
Āratī Sāī Bābā

content.shloka:
Vakratunda Mahakaya Suryakoti Samaprabha
Nirvighnam Kuru Me Deva Sarva Karyeshu Sarvada
content.meaning: O Lord with a curved trunk and massive body, whose brilliance equals a billion suns, please make all my endeavors free from obstacles, always.
content.transliteration:
Vakratuṇḍa mahākāya sūryakoṭi samaprabha
Nirvighnaṃ kuru me deva sarva kāryeṣu sarvadā

content.shloka:
Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesh Deva
Mata Jaki Parvati Pita Mahadeva
Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesh Deva
content.meaning: Victory to Lord Ganesh, victory to Ganesh Deva. Whose mother is Parvati and father is the great Lord Shiva.
content.transliteration:
Jai Gaṇeś jai Gaṇeś jai Gaṇeś devā
Mātā jākī Pārvatī pitā Mahādevā
Jai Gaṇeś jai Gaṇeś jai Gaṇeś devā

content.shloka:
Ek Dant Dayavant Char Bhuja Dhari
Mastak Par Tilak Sohe Muse Ki Savari
Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesh Deva
content.meaning: The compassionate one with a single tusk and four arms. A tilak shines on his forehead and a mouse is his vehicle.
content.transliteration:
Ek daṃt dayāvaṃt chār bhujā dhārī
Mastak par tilak sohe mūse kī savārī
Jai Gaṇeś jai Gaṇeś jai Gaṇeś devā

content.shloka:
Pan Chadhe Phool Chadhe Aur Chadhe Meva
Ladduan Ka Bhog Lage Sant Karen Seva
Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesh Deva
content.meaning: Betel leaves are offered, flowers are offered, and dry fruits too. Laddoos are offered as food, and saints serve him.
content.transliteration:
Pān chaḍhe phūl chaḍhe aur chaḍhe mevā
Laḍḍuaṃ kā bhog lage saṃt kareṃ sevā
Jai Gaṇeś jai Gaṇeś jai Gaṇeś devā

content.shloka:
Andhan Ko Aankh Det Kodhin Ko Kaya
Banjhan Ko Putra Det Nirdhan Ko Maya
Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesh Deva
content.meaning: He gives sight to the blind and heals the lepers. He grants children to the childless and wealth to the poor.
content.transliteration:
Aṃdhāṃ ko āṃkh det koḍhiṃ ko kāyā
Bāṃjhaṃ ko putra det nirdhāṃ ko māyā
Jai Gaṇeś jai Gaṇeś jai Gaṇeś devā

content.shloka:
Surshyam Ko Daet Tum Jab Aave Sharan Tihari
Sur Nar Muni Jan Kavat Dau Sharan Tihari
Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesh Deva
content.meaning: You grant boons to those who come to your refuge. Gods, men, sages, and poets all seek your shelter.
content.transliteration:
Surśyām ko dāet tum jab āve śaraṇ tihārī
Sur nar munī jan kavat dau śaraṇ tihārī
Jai Gaṇeś jai Gaṇeś jai Gaṇeś devā

content.shloka:
Deenan Ki Laaj Rakhao Shambhu Sut Vaari
Kaamna Ko Puri Karo Jag Baalihaari
Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesh Deva
content.meaning: O son of Shambhu, protect the honor of the humble. Fulfill our desires, we sacrifice ourselves to you.
content.transliteration:
Dīnāṃ kī lāj rakhao Śaṃbhu sut vārī
Kāmnā ko purī karo jag bālihārī
Jai Gaṇeś jai Gaṇeś jai Gaṇeś devā

content.shloka:
Ai Mahalakshmi Tujha Namila
Prathama Aamhi Archiyela
Aarti Mahalakshmichi
Bhakticha Daan Deii Raji Ho Raji Ho
content.meaning: O Mahalakshmi, we bow to you. First, we worship you. This is the aarti of Mahalakshmi. Grant us the gift of devotion, be pleased, be pleased.
content.transliteration:
Aī Mahālakṣmī tujhā namīlā
Pratham āmhī archīyelā
Āratī Mahālakṣmīchī
Bhaktīchā dān deī rājī ho rājī ho

content.shloka:
Sarva Mangal Sarvarthi Sarveshwari Maye
Sarvapuja Prathampuja Tujhya Padi Rahe
Aarti Mahalakshmichi
content.meaning: You are all-auspicious, fulfiller of all purposes, supreme Goddess. All worship begins with you, we remain at your feet.
content.transliteration:
Sarva maṅgaḷ sarvārthī Sarveśvarī māye
Sarvapūjā prathampūjā tujhyā padī rahe
Āratī Mahālakṣmīchī

content.shloka:
Ashta Bhuja Ashtami Rukmini Satyabhama
Gayatri Savitri Tujhya Nanat Naama
Aarti Mahalakshmichi
content.meaning: You are the eight-armed one of the eighth day, you are Rukmini and Satyabhama. You are Gayatri and Savitri, you have countless names.
content.transliteration:
Aṣṭa bhujā aṣṭamī Rukmiṇī Satyabhāmā
Gāyatrī Sāvitrī tujhyā nānat nāmā
Āratī Mahālakṣmīchī

content.shloka:
Kamala Padmavasa Padmapriya Padmagandhe
Bhaktanchi Rakshani Bhuktimukti Dayini
Aarti Mahalakshmichi
content.meaning: O lotus-dweller, lover of the lotus, with the fragrance of the lotus. You are the protector of devotees and the giver of worldly pleasures and liberation.
content.transliteration:
Kamalā padmāvāsā padmapriyā padmagandhe
Bhaktāṃchī rakṣaṇī bhuktimukti dāyinī
Āratī Mahālakṣmīchī

content.shloka:
Daridriya Dahan Karunamayi Panchsheelaa
Kalpavallari Kamadhenu Tujhya Divya Leela
Aarti Mahalakshmichi
content.meaning: O compassionate one who burns poverty, you embody the five virtues. You are the wish-fulfilling creeper and the divine cow, wondrous are your divine plays.
content.transliteration:
Dāridriya dahana karuṇāmayī pāñcśīlā
Kalpavallari kāmadhenu tujhyā divya līlā
Āratī Mahālakṣmīchī

content.shloka:
Ai Mahalakshmi Tujha Namila
Prathama Aamhi Archiyela
Aarti Mahalakshmichi
Bhakticha Daan Deii Raji Ho Raji Ho
content.meaning: O Mahalakshmi, we bow to you. First, we worship you. This is the aarti of Mahalakshmi. Grant us the gift of devotion, be pleased, be pleased.
content.transliteration:
Aī Mahālakṣmī tujhā namīlā
Pratham āmhī archīyelā
Āratī Mahālakṣmīchī
Bhaktīchā dān deī rājī ho rājī ho

content.shloka:
Udo Udo Ambe Udo Udo Ambe
Maza Nijas Chinta Layi Amba Ubhi
Aarti Ambabai
content.meaning: Arise, arise O Amba! Arise O Amba! Mother Amba stands taking care of my true worries.
content.transliteration:
Uḍo uḍo Aṃbe uḍo uḍo Aṃbe
Mājhā nijās chintā lāyī Aṃbā ubhī
Āratī Aṃbābāī

content.shloka:
Simhavaahini Maa Jagadambe
Chaturvedi Paritoshini Triloki Rakhvali
Aarti Ambabai
content.meaning: O Mother of the world, who rides a lion. You are pleased by the four Vedas and are the protector of the three worlds.
content.transliteration:
Siṃhavāhinī Mā Jagadaṃbe
Chaturvedī paritoṣiṇī trilokī rakhvālī
Āratī Aṃbābāī

content.shloka:
Chandranana Padmini Durga Jag Janani
Sankat Nivaarini Maata Bhavani
Aarti Ambabai
content.meaning: Moon-faced, seated on a lotus, Durga the mother of the world. O Mother Bhavani, remover of all calamities.
content.transliteration:
Chandranana padminī Durgā jag jananī
Saṅkaṭ nivāriṇī Mātā Bhavānī
Āratī Aṃbābāī

content.shloka:
Bhakta Jananchya Kaaj Savare
Sankatasthiti Mukta Kare
Karunasindhoo Maaye Ambabai
Aarti Ambabai
content.meaning: You fulfill the needs of your devotees. You free them from all calamities. O ocean of compassion, Mother Ambabai.
content.transliteration:
Bhakta janāṃchyā kāj sāvare
Saṅkaṭasthiti mukta kare
Karuṇāsiṃdhū māye Aṃbābāī
Āratī Aṃbābāī

content.shloka:
Kolhapurvasi Ambabai Jaga Tarini
Bhaktachya Sankat Haarini Dukha Nivaarini
Aarti Ambabai
content.meaning: Ambabai who resides in Kolhapur, savior of the world. Remover of devotees' troubles and eliminator of sorrows.
content.transliteration:
Kolhāpurvāsī Aṃbābāī jagā tāriṇī
Bhaktāchyā saṅkaṭ hāriṇī duḥkh nivāriṇī
Āratī Aṃbābāī

content.shloka:
Udo Udo Ambe Udo Udo Ambe
Maza Nijas Chinta Layi Amba Ubhi
Aarti Ambabai
content.meaning: Arise, arise O Amba! Arise O Amba! Mother Amba stands taking care of my true worries.
content.transliteration:
Uḍo uḍo Aṃbe uḍo uḍo Aṃbe
Mājhā nijās chintā lāyī Aṃbā ubhī
Āratī Aṃbābāī

content.shloka:
Yelkot Yelkot Jai Malhar
Jejuricha Banai Rajasa Mangal Har
Aarti Khandobachi
content.meaning: Hail, hail, victory to Malhar! The king of Jejuri, remover of all inauspiciousness.
content.transliteration:
Yeḷkoṭ yeḷkoṭ jai Malhar
Jejurīchā bāṇāī rājāsā maṅgaḷ har
Āratī Khaṇḍobāchī

content.shloka:
Mani Malla Daitya Sanhaari
Khanderayache Ang Bhandaryane Bhari
Tuljapuri Bhavani Priykar Khanderai
Aarti Khandobachi
content.meaning: He destroyed the demons Mani and Malla. Khanderaya's body is covered with turmeric. Bhavani of Tuljapur is dear to Khanderai.
content.transliteration:
Maṇī Mallā daitya saṃhārī
Khaṇḍerāyāche aṅg bhaṇḍāryāne bharī
Tuḷjāpurī Bhavānī priykar Khaṇḍerāī
Āratī Khaṇḍobāchī

content.shloka:
Mhalsa Banai Saundarya Rashi
Shobhati Khanderaya Pashi
Bhakta Jananche Kalyan Kari
Aarti Khandobachi
content.meaning: Mhalsa Banai is the epitome of beauty. She shines beside Khanderaya. He ensures the welfare of his devotees.
content.transliteration:
Mhaḷsā Bāṇāī saundarya rāśī
Śobhatī Khaṇḍerāyā pāśī
Bhakta janāṃche kalyāṇ karī
Āratī Khaṇḍobāchī

content.shloka:
Ashwa Vaahana Khanda Martanda
Bhakti Karita Maga Nahi Danda
Premache Bhukela Khanderaya Deva
Aarti Khandobachi
content.meaning: He rides a horse, the mighty Martanda. For those who worship him, there is no punishment. Lord Khanderaya hungers for love and devotion.
content.transliteration:
Aśva vāhanā Khaṇḍā Mārtaṇḍā
Bhaktī karitā māg nāhī daṇḍā
Premāche bhukelā Khaṇḍerāyā devā
Āratī Khaṇḍobāchī

content.shloka:
Champa Shashthi Diwali Utsav Jejuri Nagari
Bhandara Udhalit Bhakta Chali Jejuri Nagari
Bhandara Laaviti Sare Bhakta Harshe
Aarti Khandobachi
content.meaning: The festival of Champa Shashthi is celebrated in the city of Jejuri. Devotees shower turmeric as they walk to the city of Jejuri. All devotees joyfully apply turmeric.
content.transliteration:
Chaṃpā ṣaṣṭhī dīvāḷī utsav Jejurī nagarī
Bhaṇḍārā udhāḷit bhakta chalī Jejurī nagarī
Bhaṇḍārā lāvitī sāre bhakta harṣe
Āratī Khaṇḍobāchī

content.shloka:
Yelkot Yelkot Jai Malhar
Jejuricha Banai Rajasa Mangal Har
Aarti Khandobachi
content.meaning: Hail, hail, victory to Malhar! The king of Jejuri, remover of all inauspiciousness.
content.transliteration:
Yeḷkoṭ yeḷkoṭ jai Malhar
Jejurīchā bāṇāī rājāsā maṅgaḷ har
Āratī Khaṇḍobāchī
